name: Atomic Addons for Elementor – 210+ Elementor Widgets, Templates, Mega Menu & WooCommerce Builder
author: Oyorox

sections.description:
Atomic Addons for Elementor is the all-in-one Elementor addons plugin: 210+ Elementor widgets, an Elementor template library, a mega menu builder, a header footer builder, a theme builder and a complete WooCommerce builder in one lightweight install. Tested with Elementor 4.

Live Demos | All Elementor Widgets | WooCommerce Extensions | Documentation | Atomic Addons Pro

Stop stacking five plugins to finish one website. Atomic Addons for Elementor replaces the widgets pack, the header footer builder, the mega menu plugin, the WooCommerce store builder and a dozen WooCommerce extensions with a single addon for Elementor that keeps your site fast. Drag, drop, publish. No code.

32 Elementor widgets, 5 Elementor extensions, the template library, Live Copy Paste, Duplicator and SVG Support are free forever in the WordPress.org package. Atomic Addons Pro unlocks the other 129 Pro widgets, 17 Pro extensions, the builders, 77 Dynamic Tags, 46 Display Conditions and 12 WooCommerce extensions on the same install.

Why Choose Atomic Addons for Elementor?

  • 161 Elementor widgets (32 free, 129 Pro) covering content, creative design, navigation, forms, marketing, posts and WooCommerce
  • Elementor 4 ready. Tested with Elementor 4.2. Atomic Addons widgets work on the same page as Elementor 4 Atomic Elements, so you can move to the Atomic Editor without rebuilding a thing
  • Lightweight addons for Elementor. Every widget loads only the CSS and JavaScript it uses, and every widget and extension has its own on/off switch
  • Elementor template library with importable Elementor templates and blocks, included free
  • Header footer builder and theme builder for headers, footers, single posts and single products (Pro)
  • Mega menu builder that puts full Elementor sections inside your menus (Pro)
  • WooCommerce builder for Elementor with 36 WooCommerce widgets and 12 WooCommerce extensions (Pro)
  • 77 Dynamic Tags and 46 Display Conditions for dynamic content and conditional visibility (Pro)
  • Works with any WordPress theme, with the free Elementor plugin or Elementor Pro, and alongside other Elementor addons
  • A new release every few weeks with new Elementor widgets, templates and fixes. Read the changelog below

Built for Elementor 4 and the Atomic Editor

Elementor 4 introduced the Atomic Editor and Atomic Elements. Atomic Addons for Elementor is tested with Elementor 4.2.4 and runs alongside Atomic Elements on the same page. Atomic Addons widgets are classic Elementor widgets, so they work in Elementor 3 sites, in Elementor 4 sites, inside containers and inside legacy sections. Upgrade Elementor when you are ready; your Atomic Addons layouts keep working.

32 Free Elementor Widgets

All 32 free widgets for Elementor below ship in the WordPress.org package, no upgrade needed. Click a widget name to open its live demo.

Content and Layout Widgets

  • Accordion – Collapsible FAQ and content accordions with smooth animations and full typography control
  • Fancy List – Styled feature lists and checklists with custom icons, dividers and hover states
  • Featured Box – Service and feature boxes with icon, heading, description and link
  • Call Out – Highlight offers and key messages with an icon and an inline call to action
  • Image Stack – Layered, overlapping image compositions with custom offsets
  • Business Hours – Opening hours tables for shops, clinics and restaurants
  • Barcode – Generate barcodes and QR style codes for products, tickets and events
  • Search – Styled site search field for headers and landing pages
  • Static Carousel – Turn any custom slides into a touch friendly, responsive Elementor carousel
  • Brand Carousel – Client and partner logo carousel with autoplay and swipe
  • Brand Grid – Sponsor and client logo grid with hover effects
  • Total Count – Animated counters for stats, milestones and social proof numbers

Creative and Media Widgets

  • Slider – Full width Elementor slider with captions, buttons, autoplay and transitions
  • Creative Button – Animated Elementor buttons with gradient, hover and icon effects for high converting CTAs
  • Dual Button – Two call to action buttons side by side with an optional separator badge
  • Animated Link – Hover links with underline, slide and reveal effects
  • Hover Box – Reveal hidden content, text or links on hover
  • Hover Video – Silent video preview on hover for portfolios and product showcases
  • Image Accordion – Horizontal or vertical image accordion that expands on hover or click
  • Image Compare – Before and after comparison with a draggable handle
  • Image Expand – Expanding image panels for galleries and feature showcases

Menu and Navigation Widgets

  • Navbar – Responsive navigation bar with dropdowns for any WordPress menu
  • Mobile Menu – Off canvas mobile navigation with a customizable hamburger toggle
  • Dropbar – Drop down content bars for announcements, promos and quick links
  • Scrollnav – One page scroll navigation with active section highlighting

Form and User Widgets

  • Contact Form 7, WPForms, Ninja Forms, Forminator Forms and Everest Forms – Style any form plugin inside Elementor with full design control
  • User Register – Front end registration form with custom fields and redirects
  • Age Gate – Age verification popup for restricted or 18+ content with cookie memory

Free Elementor Extensions and Features

Five Elementor extensions apply to sections, columns and containers in the free package:

  • Backdrop Filter – Blur, brightness and backdrop filter effects
  • Grid Line – Decorative grid lines and layout guides on containers
  • Ripple Effects – Ripple animations on click or hover
  • Tooltip – Custom tooltips with position, style and trigger options
  • Wrapper Link – Make any container or section fully clickable

Free workflow features that other Elementor addons often charge for:

  • Template Library – Browse ready made Elementor templates and blocks and import them with one click
  • Live Copy Paste – Copy Elementor content between pages and even between sites
  • Duplicator – Duplicate posts, pages and templates in one click
  • SVG Support – Upload and use sanitised SVG files in Elementor

Elementor Template Library

Skip the blank canvas. Open the template library, pick a landing page, business page, portfolio, shop or blog layout from the ready made Elementor templates, import it and edit every element with the standard Elementor controls. Every imported Elementor template stays fully editable, and new Elementor templates are added with updates.

Lightweight Elementor Addons: Performance by Design

Most Elementor addons load their full stylesheet on every page. Atomic Addons for Elementor uses conditional asset loading instead, so a page only loads the CSS and JavaScript for the Elementor widgets it actually contains. Widgets and extensions you do not use can be switched off under Atomic Addons > Settings and never touch your front end. No jQuery-heavy bundles, no global stylesheets for features you never enabled.

Atomic Addons Pro: 129 Pro Elementor Widgets

Atomic Addons Pro adds 129 Pro widgets for Elementor on top of the free set, more than most Elementor addons offer in total. Click any name for its live demo.

WooCommerce widgets (36): Add To Cart, Additional Information, Call For Price, Cart Page, Checkout Page, Compare Products, Mini Cart, My Account Page, Order Page, Product Accordion, Product Carousel, Product Category, Product Category Carousel, Product Description, Product Filters, Product Grid, Product Image, Product Image Accordion, Product Image Hotspot, Product List, Product Meta, Product Price, Product Rating, Product Recommendations, Product Related, Product Review Carousel, Product Reviews, Product Slider, Product Stock, Product Table, Product Tabs, Product Title, Single Product Page, Sub Category, Sub Category Carousel, Wishlist Products

Post, blog and dynamic widgets (32): Post Grid, Post Carousel, Post Slider, Post List, Post List Carousel, Post Timeline, Post Horizontal Timeline, Post Vertical Timeline, Post Gallery, Post Hover Box, Post Hover List, Post Featured List, Post Tiny List, Post Stories Slider, Post Video Slider, Animated Post List, Checkerboard, News Ticker, Dynamic Grid, Dynamic Carousel, Dynamic Tabs, Dynamic Accordion, FAQ, Category Carousel, Tag Cloud, Author, Recent Comments, Post Title, Post Content, Post Featured Image, Post Info, Post Comments

Content widgets (26): Advanced Heading, Advanced Icon Box, Advanced Counter, Advanced Progress Bar, Progress Pie, Comparison List, Content Switcher, Interactive Tabs, Static Grid Tab, Step Flow, Table of Content, Reading Progress, Scroll Button, Modal, Price List, Member, Circle Info, Marker, Changelog, Document Viewer, Audio Player, Open Street Map, Logo Grid, Logo Carousel, Static Product Grid, Static Product Carousel

Creative widgets (12): Animated Heading, Flip Box, Interactive Card, Interactive Links, Advanced Image Gallery, Creative Gallery, Video Gallery, Lightbox, Lottie Image, Marquee, Stacker, SVG Blob

Menu and navigation widgets (9): Mega Menu, Sub Menu, Vertical Menu, Circle Menu, Off Canvas, Remote Arrows, Remote Fraction, Remote Pagination, Remote Thumbs

Marketing, social and form widgets (14): Countdown, Price Table, Social Proof, Social Share, Google Reviews, Review Card Grid, Review Card Carousel, Instagram Feed, Facebook Feed, Twitter Grid, Contact Form, Webhook Form, Mailchimp, User Login

Elementor Theme Builder and Header Footer Builder (Pro)

Design custom headers and footers visually with the Elementor header footer builder, then go further with the theme builder: single post layouts, single product templates and archive-style layouts, all built with Elementor and assigned site wide or per page. Combine the Navbar, Mega Menu, Sub Menu, Mini Cart, Search and Off Canvas widgets, set sticky behaviour and stop editing theme files for good. Seventeen dedicated theme builder widgets (Post Title, Post Content, Post Info, Product Image, Product Price, Product Tabs and more) appear under Atomic Addons Pro (Single) in the editor.

Mega Menu Builder for Elementor (Pro)

Build multi-column dropdowns with any Elementor content inside: images, product grids, forms, icons and buttons. The Elementor mega menu supports off canvas mobile layouts, custom icons and badges, and works with any WordPress menu.

WooCommerce Builder for Elementor (Pro)

Turn Elementor into a complete WooCommerce builder. Design the single product page, shop and category archives, cart page, checkout page, order page and My Account page with the 36 WooCommerce widgets above, then extend the store with 12 WooCommerce extensions. Each extension has its own on/off toggle and settings panel under Atomic Addons > WooCommerce, so your shop only loads what it uses.

  • Variation Swatches – Turn attribute dropdowns into color, image, label and button swatches
  • Quick View – Product preview modal with gallery, price and add to cart
  • Product Wishlist – Save products to a wishlist with a My Account tab and the [atomel_wishlist] shortcode
  • Product Compare – Side by side comparison tables shoppers can build themselves
  • Currency Switcher – Local currencies with live exchange rates, fees and rounding
  • Checkout Field Editor – Add, edit, reorder and validate checkout fields on classic and block checkout
  • One Page Checkout – Product selection and checkout on a single page
  • Role Based Pricing – Prices per user role, wholesale tiers, and the option to hide price and add to cart for selected roles or guests
  • Subscriptions – Recurring products, renewals and a My Account subscriptions dashboard
  • Min / Max Quantities – Minimum and maximum order quantities per product and per cart
  • Sales Notifications – Social proof purchase popups from recent orders
  • Product Recommendations – Upsell, cross-sell and frequently bought together blocks on product, cart, checkout and thank you pages, plus the [atomel_recommendations] shortcode

Dynamic Tags and Display Conditions (Pro)

Seventy-seven Dynamic Tags pull post fields, ACF fields, WooCommerce data, images, URLs and text into any Elementor control. Forty-six Display Conditions show or hide widgets, sections and containers by user role, login state, date and time, post type, WooCommerce cart contents, device and more. Build one layout that adapts to every visitor.

Pro Elementor Extensions (17)

  • Parallax Effects, Floating Effects, Reveal Effects and Transform Effects – Scroll and motion effects for any element
  • Particles, Animated Gradient Background, Liquid Glass Effects and Text Gradient Background – Backgrounds and glassmorphism that make sections stand out
  • Cursor Effects, Confetti Effects and Notation – Custom cursors, celebrations and hand drawn highlights
  • Sticky, Equal Height and Scroll Box – Layout helpers for sticky sections, even columns and scroll areas
  • Custom CSS / JS, AdBlock Detector and Global Badge – Scoped code, ad blocker fallbacks and reusable badges

Free vs Pro

  • Free (WordPress.org): 32 Elementor widgets, 5 extensions, Elementor templates library, Live Copy Paste, Duplicator, SVG Support, responsive controls and per-widget on/off switches. No API keys to configure.
  • Atomic Addons Pro: all 161 widgets, 22 extensions, header footer builder, theme builder, mega menu builder, WooCommerce builder, 12 WooCommerce extensions, 77 Dynamic Tags, 46 Display Conditions and priority support. See Pro plans.

Install the free Elementor addons, drag one widget onto a page and decide in five minutes.

Who Uses Atomic Addons for Elementor?

  • Freelancers who ship client sites faster with ready made Elementor widgets and Elementor templates
  • Agencies that want one consistent set of widgets for Elementor across every project
  • WooCommerce store owners who need full design control over product, cart and checkout pages
  • Bloggers and publishers using post grids, timelines, sliders and reading progress
  • Business owners building a professional site with beginner friendly Elementor addons and no developer

Documentation and Support

Read the documentation, browse the live demos or ask in the WordPress.org support forum. Found a bug or want a widget we do not have yet? Tell us; user requests drive the roadmap. Enjoying these Elementor addons? A review on WordPress.org helps other Elementor users find Atomic Addons.

More Free Plugins From Oyorox

  • Atomic Slider Addons for Elementor – Sliders and dynamic sections for Elementor
  • Atomic Social Kit – Social sharing and follow features for WordPress
  • Prime Accessibility – Accessibility tools that make your content easier for everyone to use
sections.installation:
Installing Atomic Addons for Elementor takes less than a minute, and every free Elementor widget is available right after activation.

Automatic installation (recommended)

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Search for Atomic Addons for Elementor.
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  4. Make sure the Elementor page builder is installed and active.
  5. Open any page with Elementor and find the Atomic Addons widgets in the editor panel.
  6. Open Atomic Addons > Templates to import ready made Elementor templates.

Manual installation

  1. Upload the atomic-elements folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Open the Elementor editor and start using the Atomic Addons widgets.

Minimum requirements

  • WordPress 6.5 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • Elementor page builder (the free version is enough)
  • WooCommerce (only for the WooCommerce widgets and extensions)
sections.faq:
What is Atomic Addons for Elementor?

Atomic Addons is an Elementor addons plugin with 161 Elementor widgets (32 free, 129 Pro), Elementor templates, extensions, a header footer builder, a mega menu builder, a theme builder and a WooCommerce builder. It extends Elementor so you can build professional WordPress websites without custom code.

Is Atomic Addons free?

Yes. The free version on WordPress.org includes 32 Elementor widgets, 5 extensions, the template library, Live Copy Paste, Duplicator and SVG Support with no time limit. Atomic Addons Pro is optional and adds the remaining widgets, the builders, Dynamic Tags, Display Conditions and the WooCommerce extensions.

Does Atomic Addons work with Elementor 4 and the Atomic Editor?

Yes. Atomic Addons is tested with Elementor 4.2.4. Its widgets are classic Elementor widgets, and Elementor 4 lets classic widgets and Atomic Elements live on the same page, so you can use both together. Atomic Addons widgets are not Atomic Elements themselves.

Do I need Elementor Pro to use Atomic Addons?

No. Atomic Addons works with the free Elementor plugin. If you already use Elementor Pro, both run side by side.

Is Atomic Addons a good Elementor addon for WooCommerce?

Yes. Atomic Addons Pro includes 36 WooCommerce widgets, a WooCommerce builder for single product, shop, cart, checkout, order and My Account pages, and 12 WooCommerce extensions such as Variation Swatches, Quick View, Wishlist, Compare, Currency Switcher, Subscriptions and One Page Checkout. WooCommerce must be installed for these features.

Will Atomic Addons slow down my Elementor website?

No. Atomic Addons loads widget CSS and JavaScript only on pages that use those widgets, and you can disable any widget or extension you do not need from the settings screen.

Can I build a custom header and footer with Atomic Addons?

Yes. Atomic Addons Pro includes an Elementor header footer builder and a theme builder for headers, footers, single posts and single product templates.

Does Atomic Addons include Elementor templates?

Yes. The free template library includes ready made Elementor templates and blocks. Import one, then change the text, images, colors and spacing in Elementor.

Can I use Atomic Addons with other Elementor addons?

Yes. Atomic Addons runs alongside other Elementor addon plugins and any WordPress theme. If several plugins provide overlapping features, test the combination on a staging site first.

How do I add more widgets to Elementor?

Install an Elementor addons plugin such as Atomic Addons. After activation the new widgets appear in the Elementor editor panel under Atomic Addons and can be dragged onto any page.

Is Atomic Addons responsive?

Yes. Every Atomic Addons widget has responsive controls for desktop, tablet and mobile, including spacing, alignment, sizing and visibility.

Does Atomic Addons support dynamic content?

Yes. Atomic Addons Pro includes 77 Dynamic Tags for posts, ACF, WooCommerce, images, URLs and text, and 46 Display Conditions for showing or hiding content by rules.

Where do I get support?

Post in the WordPress.org support forum for the free plugin, or contact us through atomicaddons.com for Pro support. Documentation lives at oyorox.com/docs.

Lightweight Elementor Addons: Performance by Design

Most Elementor addons load their full stylesheet on every page. Atomic Addons for Elementor uses conditional asset loading instead, so a page only loads the CSS and JavaScript for the Elementor widgets it actually contains. Widgets and extensions you do not use can be switched off under Atomic Addons > Settings and never touch your front end. No jQuery-heavy bundles, no global stylesheets for features you never enabled.
